liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Know You Rider** (3 reviews): Jerry belted the northbound train line with emphasis, and the reviewer felt he was singing right at them; Simulated locomotive headlights swept through the crowd during Jerry's headlight verse; reviewer calls it among the all-time best China>Rider [6][7][15]
- **Feel Like a Stranger** (1 review): A drawn-out version, very similar to the 1989 Alpine one made famous by the VHS/DVD release [13]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): A roughly 20-second pause precedes the full start, with the drummers in sync so the crowd could clap along [13]
- **Gimme Some Lovin'** (1 review): Jerry cut off Brent before a possible Gloria and went straight into The Wheel; the abrupt shift is audible [4]
- **All Along the Watchtower** (1 review): Played only for the second time ever, and it caught the crowd completely by surprise [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Space cont**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-06-26.131214.datbrad.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 141 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd87-06-26.bille.kerbel.8138.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 141 min; rated 4.34/5 by 32 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the audience recording is needed to really feel the show's intensity; Reviewer finds the recording not very good, though the performance is excellent [4][15]
- **gd1987-06-26.168706.pcm.schoeps.crandall.miller.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 147 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer and friends had lawn tickets but got down to the third row on Jerry's side [6]
- Reviewer drove from Long Island and found all three nights great; the second set had odd effects throughout [8]
- This was an evening show, while the following two shows were afternoon affairs [9]
- Reviewer and friends climbed the garbage-heap hill after the show to view the crowd below [14]
- Reviewer ranks it among the best Alpine shows, with the second-set China through Eyes stretch especially strong [4]
- Chicago-area fan calls it the most memorable of the hundred or so shows he saw [7]
- Reviewer counts it among the highest-energy shows seen, with Friday standing out [8]
- Many reviewers on the page name China>Rider and call this one of the best shows of the 1980s [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-06-26.131214.datbrad.flac16**: taped by datbrad; transferred by datbrad; source: OTS 2 Nakamichi CM100s w/10v batt/cP4 shotguns(XY)>Sony TCD5M (Maxell MX90s); [1]
- **gd87-06-26.bille.kerbel.8138.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD> Nakamichi 300 microphones> Sony D5 deck> master cassette [2]
- **gd1987-06-26.168706.pcm.schoeps.crandall.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Crandall; transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller  September 5, 2024; source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC3/MK4 > PCM Master > FLAC [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-06-27 Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-06-27-alpine-valley-music-theatre-east-troy-wi-usa/) [17]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-06-26 Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-06-26-alpine-valley-music-theatre-east-troy-wi-usa/) [18]
